title: Bottom Liquid-Water Sensible-Energy Quadrature Contract Freeze

invariants.assessment: The contract consumes the existing accepted-route carrier and defines no second kernel or SWAP variant.
The proposed evaluator is pure computational composition and has no file, format, parser, unit-number or path semantics.
Immutable energy configuration, worker-local carrier scratch, physical state and candidate energy results remain separate categories.
No energy sample history or ledger field is added to persistent column continuation state.
Accepted-route sample history remains worker/job-local scratch owned by the EB-I13 runtime carrier.
Evaluation is O(accepted samples), optional and compatible with pooled or batched logical-column storage.
Only selected accepted-route samples may contribute; rejected trial energy is discarded with the existing transaction lifecycle.
The contract forbids reconstruction solves and derives energy cheaply from preserved accepted-route provenance.
All semantics use arbitrary sample and outer intervals [t0,t1]; no calendar or day boundary is introduced.
The rule applies to arbitrary coupling-window placement and duration through the accepted sample sequence.
The design preserves rollback and accepted-candidate provenance needed by coupling and leaves accepted publication to runtime/coupler composition.
No head or water-flux coupling contract is changed. Energy consumes the same authoritative signed bottom-water transfer.
The evaluator never rebooks water mass. Missing thermal provenance makes energy incomplete rather than changing the water ledger.
Groundwater-interface response sensitivities are unaffected.
No extra Richards or thermal solve is permitted; evaluation cost is linear in retained accepted samples.
No heavy solver instance or persistent energy history is introduced per MultiSWAP column; evaluation is sparse and optional.
The energy rule has no knowledge of MODFLOW-cell fractions or surface tiles.
External inward donor temperature ownership remains outside SWAP and may belong to a deep-vadose or groundwater component.
The design requires the same accepted mass transfer to carry any associated energy and forbids mass rebooking or silent loss.
The public rule consumes solver-independent accepted-route samples, not Richards or HeadCalc internals; alternative solvers may supply equivalent samples.
The design reuses existing water and thermal physics and adds only an accounting composition, not duplicate process implementations.
The quadrature contract depends on public carrier semantics and terminal local donor temperature provenance, not HeadCalc arrays.
The terminal-temperature rule is explicitly numerical accounting policy tied to current water discretization; it does not silently change physical options.
Cost is bounded by the already-bounded accepted sample count; missing provenance fails closed without retry amplification.
The current terminal-flux/right-endpoint rule is defined as the reference accounting mode and higher-order alternatives require separate qualification.
Completeness and missing external donor provenance are explicit diagnostics; no silent fallback to local temperature or zero enthalpy is allowed.
Energy configuration and evaluation cost occur only for requested energy-enabled columns/routes.
Physical source mapping for external donor water remains a runtime/coupler responsibility outside the SWAP kernel.
No assumptions about midnight, daily runs, legacy input files or direct MODFLOW attachment are introduced.
EB-I14 explicitly audits the quadrature design against all thirty project architecture invariants before production implementation.

scientific_decisions: Use terminal local bottom donor temperature per accepted model advance because the authoritative water amount is terminal bottom flux times step duration.
Treat this as a first-order discrete-consistency rule, not an exact continuous-time integral.
Require explicit same-sample external donor temperature for nonzero inward transfer; otherwise total bottom energy is incomplete.
Keep rho_w, c_p_w and T_ref explicit immutable energy configuration.
Keep hydrologic acceptance independent from optional energy completeness until advective energy becomes governing thermal physics.
forbidden_shortcuts: aggregate accepted bottom water times final outer bottom temperature
arithmetic endpoint temperature mean combined with the current terminal-flux water amount without joint quadrature qualification
local bottom temperature substituted for external inward donor water
zero enthalpy substituted for missing external donor provenance
extra physical solves to reconstruct discarded route history
persistent per-column carrier or energy-ledger history
hard_nonclaims: external groundwater or deep-vadose temperature physics
closed soil or land-column energy balance
